name: com.sss135.editor-automation-mcp
description: Editor Automation for Unity: drive the Editor from AI agents through a single MCP tool with live wiki navigation, an attribute-driven tool framework, Roslyn-backed script execution, and a recorder/query engine. Any C# method may be turned into a tool by a single line. Works with Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor and any other MCP client. Based on Unity-MCP by Ivan Murzak (Apache-2.0).
